case_title: Acne, weight gain and irregular periods
case_summary_for_demo: 24-year-old woman seeing dermatology for acne, primary care for weight and labs, and gynecology for irregular periods. Each treats one piece.
main_concern: My acne got much worse over the last year even with treatment, I gained about 12 kg without changing much, and my periods come every two to three months. Three doctors are each treating one thing.

symptoms.symptom: Acne on the jaw and chin

symptoms.details: About 12 kg, mostly around the waist.

symptoms.symptom: Extra hair on the chin and upper lip

questions_for_panel: Why are my acne and my weight related?
Could my periods be part of the same thing?
Which doctor should I see first?
